verdict.rationale: HubSpot provides official REST APIs (contacts, custom objects, webhooks), an official CLI/SDK toolchain for developers, and official MCP servers for both CRM data and the developer platform, enabling AI-native agents to build against sanctioned interfaces. Some machine-readable discovery formats (llms.txt, openapi.json) 404, indicating minor gaps in AI-friendly documentation surfacing, but the core official SDK/API/MCP offering is well documented.
